facts.text: LIDARSubscriber is an rclpy Node constructed with the name 'lidar_subscriber'.
The constructor declares the ROS 2 parameter 'act_mode' with the default string 'sim' and reads it once through get_parameter.
With act_mode == 'sim' the node subscribes to '/LiDARSensor2D_scan' and '/TB3RoboModel_imu'; otherwise it subscribes to '/scan' and '/tb3_imu'.
The constructor initialises the node's scan_mode flag to False.
The node imports geometry_msgs.msg.Twist.
The node creates a publisher for Twist on the absolute topic '/TB3RoboAvatar_cmd_pos' with queue size 10.
The LaserScan and Imu subscriptions use one QoS profile with depth 10, BEST_EFFORT reliability and VOLATILE durability.

listener_callback runs the estimator while the estimator reports scan mode or the node's scan_mode flag is set, each time with scan_count_max=lidar_param_scan_count_max and value_threshold=lidar_param_segment_threshold; otherwise it sets x and y to 0.0.

listener_callback then fills Twist linear.x and linear.y with x and y, linear.z with 0.0 and angular.x, angular.y and angular.z with the stored angle_x, angle_y and angle_z, and publishes the message at the end of every call.
listener_imu stores the roll, pitch and yaw that euler_from_quaternion computes from the Imu orientation as angle_x, angle_y and angle_z.
euler_from_quaternion computes roll and yaw with np.arctan2 and pitch with np.arcsin.
The pinned lidar_params literals are lidar_param_scan_count_max = 50 and lidar_param_segment_threshold = 0.05.
write_pos adds 0.075 to the filtered x average when a non-None result is supplied; with no result it returns the stored average without the offset.
The estimator constructor initialises average_x, average_y and average_r to 0.0.
is_scan_mode returns True until scan() sets finalized, which scan() does only after it has collected scan_count_max scans.
run returns write_pos(None) while scan() reports that the environment scan has not finished.
KeyboardMonitor maps the keyboard input 's' to True and 'p' to False.
main connects the keyboard monitor's mode_changed signal to LIDARSubscriber.set_scan_mode.
set_scan_mode only assigns self.scan_mode under the node lock; it does not create a ROS service or action endpoint.
The README starts the node with 'ros2 run infra_sensor_urg lidar_subscriber --ros-args -p act_mode:=real' and says to pass act_mode:=sim for tests.
The README says the robot-position estimate is delivered on RobotAvator_cmd_pos and shows a ros2 topic echo of /TB3RoboAvatar_cmd_pos with linear and angular components.
The README asks the operator to wait about 30 seconds for the environment scan, then place the robot and enter s at the node's terminal.
The infra_sensor_tg15 node also creates a Twist publisher on '/TB3RoboAvatar_cmd_pos'.
tb3_controller_node subscribes to TB3RoboAvatar_cmd_pos with sensor_callback_pos.
sensor_callback_pos takes linear.x as the robot position and, in the MOVE state between 0.5 and 0.8, stops the motor unless the signal state is blue.
tb3_controller_node publishes its Twist on /TB3RoboModel_cmd_vel when act_mode is 'sim' and on /tb3_cmd_vel otherwise.
The README starts tb3_controller_node with act_mode:=real.
The infra_sensor_urg package manifest declares the licence TOPPERS.

determinism.notes: Event-driven canned transport with no estimator loop, LiDAR scan processing, ROS graph or wall-clock pacing; placeholder Twist samples do not establish position accuracy

fidelity.engine: canned:ROS 2 /TB3RoboAvatar_cmd_pos transcript (no estimator, LiDAR or physics)
gaps: the fake is a ROS-free canned transport: it answers the declared /TB3RoboAvatar_cmd_pos subscription with placeholder geometry_msgs/msg/Twist messages and runs no infra_sensor_urg node, LiDAR filter, circle fit, PyQt plotter or ROS graph
the fake pose is placeholder test data and is not derived from a LiDAR scan; it does not establish estimation accuracy, target tracking or the robot's physical position

the node's input topics /LiDARSensor2D_scan and /TB3RoboModel_imu (sim) or /scan and /tb3_imu (real) are not bound; this package observes only the node's published estimate and cannot step the estimator
geometry_msgs/msg/Twist has no header or stamp, so sampled_at is the driver's local receive stamp, not the publisher's sample time

after start-up x and y are 0.0 while the estimator collects its 50 environment scans; after the message that completes the scan they are 0.0 again until an operator enters 's' at the node's terminal prompt (KeyboardMonitor; 'p' returns to 0.0); this package sends no keyboard input and cannot tell such a 0.0 from an estimate at the sensor origin
the clone's infra_sensor_tg15 node publishes on the same /TB3RoboAvatar_cmd_pos topic; with both running, a read returns whichever message arrives first

roll, pitch and yaw come from the node's own euler_from_quaternion, whose np.arcsin returns NaN for an argument outside -1..1; such a sample never becomes a value: the SDK's rosbridge transport refuses non-finite JSON numbers and the driver refuses any non-finite component
the topic is also the position input of the clone's tb3_controller_node, which the README runs with act_mode:=real against a TurtleBot3; this package only subscribes and never publishes on it
the operator must run the pinned ROS 2 node and rosbridge; no ROS graph, simulator or hardware was started or validated here

measures.description: Read the current value of one or more sensor channels and return the values with a sampling timestamp and a monotone sequence number. Volatile channels are also available by subscription.

inputs.description: Optional channel names to return; omit or pass an empty array for all six channels. Only recognised names are returned and an unrecognised name is ignored. The channel units are metres for x, y and z and radians for roll, pitch and yaw.
inputs.name: fields

measures.name: read_position

safe_state.description: The upstream node is a passive position publisher and this package binds only its published estimate; it commands no motion, so the stock e-stop can only latch in software and no native stop is claimed.
